episodes.summary: Keep the Linden meal rota private until kitchen review. The allergy card is reopened and must include a separate-utensil step; the rota remains closed while the card is open.
episodes.goal: For the next step on Linden meal rota, keep the rota private until the kitchen review.
episodes.rationale: Both approval of the allergy card and kitchen-lead verification of utensil separation are required before posting the rota, because shared utensils can invalidate the meal plan.
episodes.outcome: The preview receipt is evidence only of the recorded local operation.
